llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads slide 2 title placeholder (idx==0) from the PPTX file using python-pptx.
EMU-to-cm conversion (top / 360000.0) is correct; 1 cm = 360000 EMU.
Position threshold min_top_cm=9.525 is the midpoint of a standard 4:3 slide (19.05 cm), a semantically valid definition of 'bottom of slide'.
Font size check uses abs(font_size_pt - 32.0) < 0.5, correctly allowing minor floating-point differences.
Partial credit (0.5 per sub-goal) is well-designed for a two-objective task.
Strong negative control resistance: initial state (top=0.76 cm, font=44pt) fails both checks.
Font size extraction checks run-level first, then paragraph-level, covering typical LibreOffice edit patterns.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: If font size is only inherited from the slide layout or master (not explicitly set in runs or paragraphs), font_size_pt will be None and the font sub-score will be 0. Consider adding a fallback to check text_frame.paragraphs[i].runs default or the shape's theme font size as a last resort, though this is unlikely to matter in practice for explicit user edits.
